grok.pulse: Weekend tape for NQ stays defensive after Friday's NVDA-led semis flush (NQ -1.24%, SOX -3.4%), with overnight Hormuz escalation (tankers hitting mines, IRGC claiming a US drone downed) and a crypto slide (BTC <$67K) adding pressure, partly offset by reports Trump may hold off on Iran strikes and US-China tariff talks ahead of the Xi meeting.
grok.bias: risk-off — NVDA leadership vacuum into Tue AMC print, ~5.15% 10Y and fresh Hormuz/Iran headlines outweigh Trump's 'may hold off on Iran' report and US-China pre-summit trade talks
items: @FirstSquawk (~5:16-5:18 AM ET): Iran navy says an oil tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine in the eastern Strait of Hormuz, the second today — Bearish NQ (CL bid)
@FirstSquawk (~7:11 AM ET): Iran's IRGC says it shot down a US MQ-1 Predator drone over Qeshm Island — Bearish NQ
@FirstSquawk (~6:17 / 6:24 AM ET): Trump tells advisers he may hold off on Iran attacks barring new provocations; Israel still pressing for a strike — Mixed NQ
@FirstSquawk (~6:49 AM ET): China, US discuss tariffs and farm trade ahead of Xi-Trump meeting — Bullish NQ
@WatcherGuru (~10:38 PM ET Fri): crypto crashing, BTC under $67K, ETH under $1,900, $330M+ liquidated — Bearish NQ (risk appetite; COIN/MSTR)
grok.trump: Per @FirstSquawk (~6:17 AM ET), Trump told advisers he may hold off on Iran attacks barring new provocations, while US officials say Israel keeps pressing for a strike (~6:24 AM ET); US and China discussing tariffs/farm trade ahead of the Xi-Trump meeting at APEC Nov 18-19 (~6:49 AM ET).
grok.watch: Weekend: Iran/Hormuz tanker and drone headlines, NVDA CEO search/probes, crypto weakness, MSFT outage fallout (services restored ~6:43 AM ET); CME futures reopen Sun 6 PM ET. Mon: Empire State 8:30 AM ET. Tue: HD/DIS BMO, FOMC minutes 2 PM ET, NVDA AMC (call 5 PM ET). Wed: TGT/LOW BMO, PANW AMC; Nov 18-19 Trump-Xi at APEC. Thu: WMT/BABA BMO, INTU AMC. QQQ 682 (200dma) / 675; 10Y vs 5.15%.
